title: Married Woman Climbs Mobile Tower for Lover After Tehsildar Assurance
summary: A married woman in Balia, India, climbed a mobile tower to meet her lover after receiving assurances from the local tehsildar. The incident has raised questions about the role of government officials in facilitating extramarital relationships.
summary_points: A married woman in Balia, India, climbed a mobile tower to meet her lover.
The incident occurred after the local tehsildar assured the woman that she would be allowed to meet her lover.
The tehsildar's intervention has raised questions about the role of government officials in facilitating extramarital relationships.
The incident highlights the challenges faced by women who are trapped in unhappy marriages and seeking escape.
The case has sparked a debate about the need for stronger laws to prevent such incidents.

इस घटना ने पत्नी-पति विवाह से निकलने वाली महिलाओं की चुनौतियों को उजागर किया है
इस मामले ने ऐसे कानूनों की आवश्यकता पर चर्चा शुरू कर दी है जो ऐसे मामलों को रोकने में मदद करेंगे।
